content.short: Shopping rewards app paying up to 5% extra in crypto or reward dollars at 100+ merchants.
content.description: RewardMe members link their email so purchases at participating stores are recognised automatically, then earn up to 5% extra in Reward Dollars or crypto. Rewards can be swapped for gift cards, and surveys and tasks add bonus earnings. It is powered by Measurable Data Token, and staking MDT unlocks higher membership tiers. World App users can sign up without leaving the wallet.
content.meta: Earn up to 5% extra back in crypto or gift cards when you shop at 100+ merchants with RewardMe, powered by MDT.
